title: Should Schools Ban Phones?
text:
Many people believe that students should not be allowed to use mobile phones during lessons. In my opinion, this rule is necessary because phones distract students from their studies. For example, many teenagers check their messages every few minutes. Furthermore, constant notifications make it difficult for pupils to concentrate for long periods. Therefore, schools should set clear and consistent limits on phone use in classrooms.

However, some teachers argue that phones can be useful tools for research and learning. Nevertheless, a complete ban may not be the best solution, since students can still use devices in secret. Instead, a better approach would be to teach young people when and how to use technology responsibly. In conclusion, balance is more effective than total prohibition.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, why does the writer think phones should be restricted?
options: Because phones are too expensive for schools
Because phones distract students from their studies
Because teachers cannot use computers in class
Because students need phones for their exams

questions.text: What do some teachers argue, according to the second paragraph?
options: Phones are useless in every lesson
Phones can be useful tools for research and learning

questions.text: Why does the writer suggest teaching responsible use instead of a total ban?
options: Because the writer believes students will never use phones
Because a ban may not stop students from using devices in secret
Because schools currently have no rules about technology
Because phones are too expensive to replace

questions.text: What can be inferred about the writer's final position?
options: They think phones have no educational value
They think phones should be allowed everywhere without limits
They think a balanced approach is better than a complete prohibition
They think teachers should decide nothing about phones

paragraph_translations: Muitas pessoas acreditam que os alunos não deveriam ter permissão para usar celulares durante as aulas. Na minha opinião, essa regra é necessária porque os celulares distraem os alunos de seus estudos. Por exemplo, muitos adolescentes verificam suas mensagens a cada poucos minutos. Além disso, as notificações constantes dificultam que os alunos se concentrem por longos períodos. Portanto, as escolas devem estabelecer limites claros e consistentes para o uso de celulares nas salas de aula.

No entanto, alguns professores argumentam que os celulares podem ser ferramentas úteis para pesquisa e aprendizagem. Mesmo assim, uma proibição total pode não ser a melhor solução, já que os alunos ainda podem usar os aparelhos escondidos. Em vez disso, uma abordagem melhor seria ensinar os jovens quando e como usar a tecnologia de forma responsável. Em conclusão, o equilíbrio é mais eficaz do que a proibição total.
